RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel appointing a man is not evidence that your sex counted against you — if anything it removes the usual inference. Raising it would read as a misreading of your own situation and would weaken the parts of your complaint that have substance.

What is worth pursuing: the two-week silence on your written explanation request, and the gap between fifteen years' experience plus five as deputy and an eight-year appointee. "Strong experience of digital media" may be a genuine, reasonable priority — or a proxy for youth. Age is the angle to watch, though a seven-year gap alone proves little.

Chase the explanation in writing, note the delay, and ask what weight digital experience carried.
